changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS ${schema_name}.IDX_STG_INGEST_ERROR_ENTITY_STATUS_CREATED RENAME TO IDX_STG_INGEST_ERROR_PREPART_ESC
ALTER INDEX IF EXISTS ${schema_name}.IDX_STG_INGEST_ERROR_OPERATION_ID RENAME TO IDX_STG_INGEST_ERROR_PREPART_OPID

CREATE TABLE ${schema_name}.STG_INGEST_ERROR ( ID BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, RUN_ID VARCHAR(100), ENTITY_NAME VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(255), OPERATION_ID VARCHAR(100), PAYLOAD_JSON JSONB, ERROR_CODE VARCHAR(128), ERROR_MESSAGE TEXT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, STATUS VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, RETRY_COUNT INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, LAST_RETRY_AT TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, REF_NAV VARCHAR(255), REF_PA_EMITTENTE VARCHAR(255), REF_TOKEN VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT STG_INGEST_ERROR_PK PRIMARY KEY (ID, CREATED_AT), CONSTRAINT CHK_STG_INGEST_ERROR_STATUS CHECK (STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'DONE', 'PARKED')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (CREATED_AT)

INSERT INTO ${schema_name}.STG_INGEST_ERROR (ID, RUN_ID, ENTITY_NAME, SOURCE_KEY, OPERATION_ID, PAYLOAD_JSON, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, LAST_RETRY_AT, REF_NAV, REF_PA_EMITTENTE, REF_TOKEN) SELECT ID, RUN_ID, ENTITY_NAME, SOURCE_KEY, OPERATION_ID, PAYLOAD_JSON, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, STATUS, RETRY_COUNT, LAST_RETRY_AT, REF_NAV, REF_PA_EMITTENTE, REF_TOKEN FROM ${schema_name}.STG_INGEST_ERROR_PREPART
